real_name: Mohammad Daddal (Rehman Dakait's father — 'Babu Dakait' in film)
real_life_notes: Rehman Dakait's father, a Karachi underworld figure himself — Rehman grew up inside a criminal household. The film names him 'Babu Dakait' and depicts the intra-family power struggle where Rehman consolidates control, with a wedding-attack sequence dramatising the real power dynamics. Rehman reportedly committed his first killings at around 13 and eventually presided over the PAC after displacing his father's generation.
film_role: Film 1 Act 1 — represents the old-guard Lyari criminal order that Rehman displaces. The wedding-attack-and-stone-killing scene is a dramatised version of the real generational power transfer in Lyari.
objective: Maintain old-guard criminal authority; resist Rehman's consolidation
real_notes: Rehman's real father was named Mohammad Daddal. The 'killing his own mother' implication in the film tracks real reportage about Rehman's extreme consolidation methods, though officially undocumented.
